ideas.pitch: An AI-powered optimization tool that coordinates RIPTA bus routes with local student schedules and weather forecasts to reduce winter wait times in Providence.
ideas.title: Providence Transit Nexus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a direct pain point felt by students and local residents in Providence during harsh winter months, aligning with the local impact patterns seen in past hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard using Poisson regression to forecast peak maintenance and IT infrastructure support tickets across campus buildings.
ideas.title: Campus Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an operational problem that university administrators and campus facilities managers experience daily, resonating strongly with judges embedded in the university ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutritional assistant that generates personalized meal plans sourcing exclusively from Providence farmers markets and local grocers.
ideas.title: Rhode Island Local Food AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines personal health utility with local economic support, offering clear, measurable community impact.

ideas.pitch: An AML and compliance risk detection platform tailored for small businesses in Rhode Island using graph intelligence and lightweight machine learning.
ideas.title: RI Small Business Risk Radar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex engineering and localized utility, appealing to judges looking for enterprise-grade technical execution within a tight weekend scope.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring tool tracking urban canopy health and industrial land compliance specifically for the greater Providence area.
ideas.title: Providence Green Space Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles environmental monitoring with concrete metrics and spatial data visualization, a proven category at previous innovation hackathons.
